model: intelligent Touch Manager (iTM) BACnet Server Gateway DCM014A51 - Outdoor Unit Objects
applies_to: VRV outdoor units (main, sub-1 and sub-2 modules) monitored through an iTM with the DCM014A51 BACnet server option.
summary: With the DCM014A51 option, each VRV outdoor unit appears behind the iTM's BACnet virtual router as its own virtual device. Common points report communication, mode, alarm, defrost, oil return, calculated power and current and outdoor air temperature, and up to three modules (main, sub-1, sub-2) add read-only refrigerant pressures, temperatures, compressor speeds, fan step and expansion valve positions.
notes: All outdoor unit objects are read-only.
Objects are only generated for data the outdoor unit actually has; a single-module system has no S1_ or S2_ objects.
Temperature units follow the iTM regional setting (Celsius or Fahrenheit); pressure and power units are not stated in the guide.
Outdoor unit devices are separate from indoor unit devices, so instance numbers can overlap with the indoor list.

source.title: intelligent Touch Manager (iTM) BACnet Server Gateway DCM014A51 Design Guide

integration.summary: Outdoor units are read-only virtual devices behind the iTM; map communication, alarm, mode and defrost status plus the module data you need. Only modules that exist on the system (main, sub-1, sub-2) generate objects.

minimum_points.name: Outdoor Air Temperature
minimum_points.why: Ambient temp sensed at the outdoor unit

minimum_points.name: Outdoor Unit Alarm Status
minimum_points.why: Outdoor unit alarm with error code

setup: Recommended outdoor unit device ID is 53PT (P = port 1-8, T = outdoor unit tag, e.g. 5311 for CU-1).
gotchas: Objects are only generated for data the outdoor unit actually provides; single-module systems have no S1_/S2_ objects.
Values are rounded to a fixed number of significant digits; temperature units follow the iTM locale.
